resources.string: Local demonstration only. No network or video is connected.
Use the remote to show a local demo request. Accept or Reject requires a separate button press. This does not discover a sender.
A local demo request is waiting. Choose Accept or Reject. No network connection or screen capture will start.

The local demo request was rejected. You can show another local request.
